_comment: Example user style pack. Copy to <home>/.lumina/styles.json (or $LUMINA_STYLES_FILE) and edit freely; it is hot-reloaded on every ps_grade call. Styles here merge over the built-in styles by name. `lut` may be null, a bare .cube file name from the local Photoshop Presets/3DLUTs folder (or a style-level `lutDir`), or an absolute path to your own .cube. `params` is deep-merged over the recipe steps, so a style can be a colour+LUT combination.

teal-orange.label: Teal & orange (bring your own LUT)
teal-orange.description: Cool shadows / warm skin look; point `lut` at your own .cube

warm-matte.label: Warm matte (parameter-only)
warm-matte.description: No LUT: a soft matte print look built from tone/vignette parameters

faded-film.label: Faded film 400 (absolute LUT path)
faded-film.description: Example of pointing at a LUT outside Photoshop's folder
